commitResults.messageTitle: Show persisted parent-student links in storage diagram
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG storage class diagram shows JsonSerializableAddressBook owning
only JsonAdaptedPerson objects. The real class also owns a list of
JsonAdaptedLink objects, so readers cannot see where parent-student
links are saved or why a hand-edited link can stop a file loading.

Let's add JsonAdaptedLink to the diagram and regenerate the PNG.
Let's also note in the Storage section that each link is stored by
names and phone numbers, and that null, duplicate, or dangling links
are rejected on load.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align User Guide pictures with their descriptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Several UG pictures do not match the text beside them. The quick start
says the first launch shows an empty list, but its picture shows five
contacts from a Windows test run. The list and view sections reuse that
same picture, and the sort, link, unlink, find, and delete pictures
show commands that none of the listed examples use.

Let's capture an empty first-launch window, a list result, and a
view 2 result from the same sample contacts as the other pictures.
Let's also add the pictured command to each section's examples, and
change the sort example to the filter shown in its picture, so every
picture matches an example on the page.

The DG Acknowledgements list notable AI use for two members but not
for jingyucodes. The course policy on reuse asks each member to
acknowledge AI tools they relied on.

Let's add an entry in the same format, naming Claude Code and the
work it assisted with: the view, link, and unlink commands and tests,
alpha-bug fixes, UG/DG updates, v1.5 release preparation, and
pull-request reviews.
Update UI diagram with contact detail panel
